title: 水理学Ⅰ
subtitle: Hydraulic Engineering I
teachers:
ARITA Mamoru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Hydraulics is the foundation of river engineering, coastal engineering, environmental engineering, and water engineering. In this course, learn about hydrostatics and Bernoulli's theorem, which are the foundations of hydraulics
advice:
In this course, students will learn the basics of hydrology, hydrostatic mechanics, continuous equations and Bernoulli's theorem.

1. Fluid dynamics basics
2. Hydrostatic mechanics
3. Equation of continuity (mass conservation law)
4. Bernoulli's theorem
5. Loss problems in pipelines
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of physics and mathematics.

activityGoals.body: Understand the physical quantities used in hydraulics [K:0.2]
Understand the loss of the pipeline [K:0.2]

achievementLevels.ideal:
Understand physical quantities related to hydraulics.
Understand hydrostatic pressure distribution, Archimedes principle and Pascal principle.
Understand continuity in fluid mechanics
Understand Bernoulli's formula in hydrodynamics
achievementLevels.standard:
Understand physical quantities related to hydraulics.
Understand hydrostatic pressure distribution, Archimedes principle and Pascal principle.

Understand Bernoulli's formula in hydrodynamics

lessons.content:
Hydrostatic pressure 1
Gauge pressure and absolute pressure

Hydrostatic pressure 3
Total water pressure acting on the plane

Hydrostatic pressure 4
Total water pressure acting on the curved
surface

Water movement 1
Flow velocity and flow rate

Water movement 2
Steady flow and equal flow
